Name: Merck & Company Inc
Description: Merck & Company Inc. is a leading American multinational pharmaceutical firm based in Kenilworth, New Jersey, renowned for its commitment to advancing global health through innovative pharmaceuticals and vaccines. Founded in 1891 as the U.S. subsidiary of the German Merck Group, the company has a rich legacy of scientific excellence and focuses on key therapeutic areas including oncology, infectious diseases, and cardiovascular health. Merck is distinguished by its strong pipeline of novel therapeutics and a robust commitment to research and development, further solidifying its role as a pivotal player in the biopharmaceutical industry. With a steadfast dedication to improving patient outcomes and access to healthcare, Merck continues to leverage its scientific expertise and strategic partnerships to drive growth and innovation in the ever-evolving healthcare landscape.
